machine: Apple Silicon (arm64 darwin), Python 3.11, numpy 1.26.4, fastembed bge-small-en-v1.5
command: PYTHONPATH=plugin python -m memory.eval_recall --memory-dir <corpus> --index-dir <index> --hard-set <fixture> --telemetry-dir <dir> --ab HIPPO_GRAPH_PPR  (bm25_queries runs: same, under HIPPO_DISABLE_DENSE=1)

corpora.live_corpus: this repo's own .claude/memory (108 memories) with its project-local fixture .claude/memory/.audit-fixtures/recall_hard_set.yaml (16 single-hop rows, 0 multi-hop)
corpora.starter_packs: the CI corpus: plugin/assets packs seeded per tests/fixtures/recall_hard_set.yaml's header (22 memories) with that fixture (10 multi-hop, 22 single-hop)

live_corpus_dense.off_arm_self_check: pass — flag-off runs byte-identical before and after the ON arm

reachability.skipped: multi-hop n=0 < 10 — a reachability baseline over the ungrown fixture is vacuous (grows it)

live_corpus_dense.footer: measures only — HIPPO_GRAPH_PPR stays default-OFF and the 1-hop lane stays; replacing it is a separate dated owner decision on affirmative evidence, never an automatic consequence of this report.

live_corpus_bm25_queries.off_arm_self_check: pass — flag-off runs byte-identical before and after the ON arm

reachability.skipped: multi-hop n=0 < 10 — a reachability baseline over the ungrown fixture is vacuous (grows it)

live_corpus_bm25_queries.footer: measures only — HIPPO_GRAPH_PPR stays default-OFF and the 1-hop lane stays; replacing it is a separate dated owner decision on affirmative evidence, never an automatic consequence of this report.

starter_packs_dense.off_arm_self_check: pass — flag-off runs byte-identical before and after the ON arm

moved.query: the plan implements the painless half of the consolidation n

starter_packs_dense.footer: measures only — HIPPO_GRAPH_PPR stays default-OFF and the 1-hop lane stays; replacing it is a separate dated owner decision on affirmative evidence, never an automatic consequence of this report.

starter_packs_bm25_queries.off_arm_self_check: pass — flag-off runs byte-identical before and after the ON arm

latency_interleaved_dense.method: one process, warm index, the hard-set queries x5 rounds, OFF/ON alternated per query (order flipped each round) so drift and cache effects hit both arms alike; the per-run latency_ms above runs the arms sequentially and is order-sensitive

reading: No precision loss anywhere (single-hop delta 0 on the live corpus under both query modes; +0.004 MRR on the starter packs). Multi-hop: +0.046 MRR at recall ceiling on the starter packs (n=10), one expected stem unreachable -> ranked as a seed; but that graph has 10 walkable pairs and no 2-hop structure, and the live corpus, whose 718-pair graph is where a multi-hop walk should pay, has no multi-hop fixture rows, so its associative gain is unmeasured. Latency: interleaved dense p50 +1.1 to +1.7 ms on a 15-20 ms call, p95 within noise; BM25-query p50 +0.2 to +0.3 ms.
recommendation: No flip yet: directionally positive with no regression, but not the affirmative multi-hop evidence the acceptance asks for. Grow the live fixture to >= 10 multi-hop rows (owner-confirmed, per row) and re-run eval --ab HIPPO_GRAPH_PPR; flip if multi-hop gains there with single-hop unchanged. Soaking HIPPO_GRAPH_PPR=1 locally meanwhile carries no observed risk.
